summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District to issue up to $624,000,000 in general obligation bonds to construct, repair, and equip college facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes a $624 million facilities bond projected not to increase current tax rates.
tax.quote: Measure G would generate an estimated $624 million, but is not projected to raise current tax rates.

schools.text: A Yes vote provides local bond funding for facility and technology improvements at Grossmont and Cuyamaca colleges.
schools.quote: All funds raised would stay local to support District facility and technology improvements.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the Measure G facilities bond or its additional funding for district projects.
tax.quote: Measure G would generate an estimated $624 million, but is not projected to raise current tax rates.

schools.text: A No vote does not provide the Measure G bond funding for Grossmont and Cuyamaca college improvements.
